The main change is the new [Vertex.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/Vertex.java:1) value type. [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/Graph.java:1), [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/DirectedGraph.java:1), [GraphTraversal.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/GraphTraversal.java:1), and [StronglyConnectedComponent.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/030_strongly_connected_components/StronglyConnectedComponent.java:1) now operate on `Vertex` objects instead of plain `int` IDs. That removes primitive obsession from the core model and makes vertex identity an explicit part of the design.
